mobileNotice.title: Continue on a computer
mobileNotice.body: This step needs a wider screen.

welcome.title: Let us open your workspace
welcome.body: We will start by identifying your agency.

body.verified: 30 minutes with our team to walk through your setup.
body.processing: Verification is under way. You can move on, we will attach the result to your file.
body.incomplete: Verification did not complete. Start it again to continue.

submitted.title: Your call is confirmed
submitted.mailConfirmation: A confirmation has been sent to you by email.
submitted.noCall: No call is booked yet. We will write to you as soon as a slot opens.

pendingNotice.title: Your entry is paused
pendingNotice.body: Every step you confirmed is already saved. Come back whenever you want, you will find your entry as you left it.

signataire.title: Who is filling in this file?
signataire.subtitle: Your identity and your role in the agency. We collect this information under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA).

agence.title: What is your agency's legal identity?
agence.subtitle: These details must match your commercial register entry exactly.

company.noResults: No company found under that name in the commercial register.
company.error: The commercial register did not answer.

address.noResults: No address found. You can type it in yourself.
address.error: The address register did not answer. You can type the address in yourself.

pieceIdentite.title: Verify your identity
pieceIdentite.missingSignataire: The signatory must be entered in the previous step first.

verification.title: You will be redirected to Stripe,
verification.pendingBody: The result arrives shortly. You can continue, we will attach it to your file.
verification.doneBody: Your document was verified and your face compared with its photo. Our compliance team then reviews the file.

errors.consent_declined: You declined the verification. You can start it again, or request a manual verification.
errors.under_supported_age: Online verification does not cover people under 16.
errors.country_not_supported: Your country is not covered by online verification. Request a manual verification: our compliance team will contact you.
errors.document_expired: The document has expired. Try again with a valid one.
errors.document_type_not_supported: This document type is not accepted. A passport or identity card works.
errors.document_unverified_other: The document could not be verified. Try again with better lighting.
errors.selfie_face_mismatch: Your face does not match the photo on the document. Try the verification again.
errors.selfie_manipulated: The face photo appears edited. Try the verification again.
errors.selfie_document_missing_photo: The document has no photo. Use a passport or an identity card.
errors.selfie_unverified_other: Your face could not be verified. Try the verification again.
errors.abandoned: The verification was interrupted. You can resume it.
errors.unknown: The verification did not succeed. You can start it again, or request a manual verification.

startFailed.unavailable: Online verification is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly, or request a manual verification.
startFailed.unexpected: Online verification could not open. Check your connection and try again, or request a manual verification.

blocked.title: Manual verification
blocked.body: Some documents cannot pass the online check: a residence permit, a passport from a country that is not covered, or a refusal you cannot fix yourself. Request a manual verification: our compliance team will contact you to establish your identity, without you having to upload any document here.
blocked.declared: Manual verification requested. Carry on: our compliance team will get in touch once your file is submitted.

verdict.match: The document matches the identity you entered.
verdict.partial: The document partly matches the identity you entered. Review the signatory step before continuing.
verdict.mismatch: The document does not match the identity you entered. Check that it is the right one.
verdict.unreadable: The document could not be read. A sharper photo helps, but you can continue.

read.expired: This document appears to have expired on {{date}}.
read.typeDiffers: The document does not appear to be the one you selected.
read.disclaimer: Automated reading, for guidance only: our compliance team reviews the document.

recap.title: Review your file before submitting it

pieceIdentite.loadFailed: Could not check the uploaded documents. Please try again.
pieceIdentite.manualReview: No completed online verification. Our compliance team will establish your identity.

rendezVous.none: No appointment yet. We will write to you as soon as a slot opens.

recap.attestation: I confirm that the information above is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.

errors.legalName: Registered name missing. Complete the Agency step.
errors.legalForm: Legal form missing. Complete the Agency step.
errors.country: Country of registration missing. Complete the Agency step.
errors.signatory: No active signatory. Complete the Signatory step.
errors.generic: The submission failed. Please try again.

notSubmitted.title: Identity verification not submitted
notSubmitted.bodyAdmin: Complete identity verification to open KYC files and send signatures.
notSubmitted.bodyOther: An administrator or manager must complete your agency's identity verification.

pendingReview.title: Verification under review
pendingReview.body: We are validating your agency's identity. The status updates automatically.

rejected.title: Verification rejected
rejected.body: Your agency's identity was not validated. Resubmitting the form does not trigger a new review: please contact support.

correctionRequested.title: Correction requested
correctionRequested.body: A correction was requested by email. Reopen the form, then submit again.

notSubmitted.title: Verify your agency's identity
notSubmitted.bodyAdmin: We verify every agency's identity before any KYC file or electronic signature, under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA). You can complete it now.
notSubmitted.bodyOther: We verify every agency's identity before any KYC file or electronic signature, under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA). Only an administrator or manager can complete it.

pendingReview.title: We are reviewing your file
pendingReview.body: Your file is with our compliance team. The status updates as soon as a decision is made.

rejected.title: Your file was not validated
rejected.body: Resubmitting the form does not trigger a new review. Contact support to learn the reason and the next steps.

unavailable.title: Verification status could not be read
unavailable.body: This is not about your file: reading the status failed. Try again in a moment, then contact support if the problem persists.

correctionRequested.title: A correction is requested
correctionRequested.body: The details were sent to you by email. Correct your entry, then submit again: the review resumes automatically.

intro.title: Book your welcome call
intro.bodyStandalone: Your file is under review. Let us take 30 minutes to walk through your setup and answer your questions.

picker.pickDayFirst: Pick a day in the calendar to see the free times.

confirmed.title: You are booked
confirmed.emailSent: A confirmation email is waiting for you, with the link and a way to reschedule if needed.

empty.noHost: No slot is open right now. We will come back to you by email as soon as we can.
empty.noSlot: Nothing free left in this period. Try the next month, or carry on: we will write to you.

errors.slot_taken: That slot was just taken. Please pick another one.
errors.already_booked: Your agency already has a call booked.
errors.slot_in_past: That slot is already in the past.
errors.call_in_past: This appointment is already in the past.
errors.call_not_active: This appointment is no longer active.
errors.reschedule_limit_reached: Reschedule limit reached. Write to us to find another date.
errors.generic: The appointment could not be saved. Please try again in a moment.

pending.title: Book your welcome call
pending.body: 30 minutes with our team to get started with MEGGA.

public.title: Your MEGGA welcome call

public.notActive: This appointment was cancelled or has already passed.
public.tooLate: This appointment is very soon: it can no longer be changed here.

cancelled.title: Appointment cancelled
cancelled.body: Noted. You can book a new one from your MEGGA workspace.

rescheduled.title: New date saved
rescheduled.body: A confirmation email with the updated date is on its way.

book.title: Welcome call
book.video: The video link is sent to you with the confirmation.
book.about: We walk through your setup, answer your questions, and tune the CRM to the way you work.
book.formIntro: Your answers save us spending half the call on these questions.
